objection_points.description: For those beneficiaries who are going ABROAD, please attach a copy of your tickets (both onward & return) and VISA copy along with your medical claims.
Kindly obtain AMO's endorsement (Signature & Seal) on the Reimbursement Form & Tax Invoice and resubmit it to Accounts.
Kindly fill in the attached Declaration Form and resubmit it to Accounts for further processing.

There is delay notice in purchasing the Medicines. Hence unable to process your medical claims. As per rule, the medicines should be purchased WITHIN SEVEN DAYS from the date of the prescription. You may submit your claims to Admin Officer CHSS-P&GA, with Condonation/justification letter for taking approval of the Competent Authority.

The claim has not been submitted within the prescribed time limit i.e., Three Months from the date of consultation. You may write a condonation letter to Admin Office-CHSS, P&GA for taking approval of the Competent Authority.

Direct payment made to the empaneled Lab or Hospital cannot be reimbursed directly by Accounts. You may submit your claim with a justification letter and Report / Discharge Summary to Admin officer – CHSS, P&GA for taking approval of the competent Authority.
Tax invoice is not tallying with Prescription. Kindly co-relate the purchased medicines with Prescription and resubmit.
Please enclose Complete Original Prescription/Discharge Summary along with the Medical claims and forward to CHSS-Accounts for processing the claim.
The submitted claim does not belong to F&A, URSC. Kindly submit it to the concerned Centre.
Date of Prescription is missing. Kindly get it incorporated and resubmit your claim to Accounts-CHSS.

Date of Tax Invoice/ Cash Bill is prior to Prescription Date, hence unable to process the claim. You may submit your claim with condonation/justification letter to Administrative Officer-CHSS, P&GA for further necessary action.

Medicine Prescribed by Specialists / Purchased by beneficiary for more than 3 months cannot be reimbursed directly by Accounts. You may submit your claim with Condonation/Justification letter to Admin Officer- CHSS, P&GA, for taking approval of the Competent Authority for purchase of medicines for more than 3 months medicines at a time.
Kindly fill the reimbursement Form (CHSS FORM-7) properly and resubmit it to Accounts. [Signature missing]
Medicines purchased are inadmissible under CHSS /CSMA Rules. Hence returned unpassed.
Please enclose ORIGINAL REFERRAL FORM along with the Medical claims and forward to CHSS-Accounts for processing the claim.
Patient Name & Doctor Name is not mentioned in the Tax Invoice/ Cash Bill.
